Moves an external-only account's sign-in identities onto a password account and deletes the external-only account (admin only). A 2.8 SSO account whose only sign-in is the matching legacy OIDC link is accepted as the target too, to merge a duplicate made by 2.9.0. The 2.8 path /users/link-oidc-to-password and its oidcUserId field are accepted too.
